Gulf States Reassess Security Spending Amid Iran War Pressures

Gulf nations are reportedly reconsidering their security spending priorities due to fiscal pressures exacerbated by the Iran war. A new report suggests these countries may shift investments from US commitments towards domestic priorities. This reassessment is driven by economic strains linked to the ongoing conflict involving Iran.
